home.hero_title: Turn your catalog into always-on product intelligence
home.hero_subtitle: Store every detail in DynamoDB, let OpenAI APIs vectorize it, and deliver conversational answers powered by a real-time VectorDB.

capture.title: 1. Capture anything
capture.body: Ingest structured data or free-form notes. Everything lands safely inside DynamoDB.

vectorize.title: 2. Vectorize automatically
vectorize.body: OpenAI embeddings convert your content into vectors instantly and sync them to our VectorDB.

answer.title: 3. Answer with context
answer.body: Every chat request retrieves the closest vectors and generates an AI response with exact context.

features.title: One hub for storing, vectorizing, and chatting about products
features.subtitle: Stay confident that every answer reflects the latest inventory state.

capture.title: Centralize knowledge
capture.body: Keep every SKU detail, launch note, and policy inside one Dynamo-backed workspace.

vectorize.title: Automatic embeddings
vectorize.body: OpenAI embeddings + vector search ensures semantic lookups are as fast as keyword search.

chat.title: Conversational replies
chat.body: Customers type natural questions and receive curated product recommendations with citations.

howto.title: Get started in a few steps
howto.body: keeps your products searchable with OpenAI + VectorDB. Follow these steps to upload inventory and start chatting.

login.description: Firstly you need to LOG IN into your account. If you don't have the account yet, Register first.

products.description: After succesful login, Go to the product page to review the inventory list. If you want, you can also add new items through the product entry form.

chat.description: Visit the chat page to ask questions. Every reply is based on the latest inventory data.
